title.zh: 演化生物學與紅皇后戰略：間斷平衡、基因轉移與絕對生存 (CEO/策略長 視角)
title.en: Evolutionary Biology & Red Queen Strategy: Punctuated Equilibrium & Absolute Survival (CEO/CSO)

slide_title.zh: 靜態競爭優勢的死亡與紅皇后假說 (SCQA & The Evolutionary Mandate)
slide_title.en: The Death of Static Advantage & The Red Queen Hypothesis (SCQA)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：企業成功導入了 GenAI 工具，提升了 20% 的生產力。高管團隊為此沾沾自喜，認為已經建立了強大的「競爭護城河」
衝突 (Complication)：這種沾沾自喜違背了演化生物學的「紅皇后假說 (Red Queen Hypothesis)」。在生態系（市場）中，掠食者與獵物是共同演化的。當你導入 AI 時，你的對手也導入了。你拼盡全力的狂奔，在數學上只能讓你「勉強留在原地」，停下腳步就是瞬間滅絕
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議徹底燒毀「永續競爭優勢」的天真商管教科書。懇請授權導入「演化生物學 (Evolutionary Biology)」框架，將企業從「追求靜態護城河」轉變為「適應高頻突變與極限生存」的演化機器
en: Situation: The enterprise successfully deploys GenAI, achieving a 20% productivity boost. The C-Suite celebrates, believing they have established a deep, sustainable 'competitive moat.'

Complication: This arrogance violates evolutionary biology's 'Red Queen Hypothesis.' In any ecosystem (market), predators and prey co-evolve simultaneously. You adopted AI, but so did your rivals. Sprinting at absolute maximum capacity mathematically only allows you to 'stay in the same place.' Stopping means instantaneous extinction.

The Ask: Proposing the absolute incineration of naive business textbooks preaching 'sustainable competitive advantage.' Requesting the mandate to deploy 'Evolutionary Biology.' We must pivot the enterprise from 'building static moats' into an evolutionary machine engineered for high-frequency mutation and extreme survival.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，我們因為今年導入了 AI 而沾沾自喜，這在生物學家眼裡是極度可笑的。《愛麗絲夢遊仙境》裡的紅皇后說過：『你必須拼命奔跑，才能保持在原地。』這就是演化生物學最著名的『紅皇后假說』！我們在進化，我們的競爭對手也在進化，連駭客和監管機構都在進化！導入 AI 不是我們的護城河，它只是我們不被大自然淘汰的『最低生存門檻』。今天的提案，是要喚醒這家公司的達爾文生存本能。不要再幻想有什麼『永續優勢』了，在 AI 軍備競賽中，我們唯一的戰略，就是讓我們的突變速度，永遠比對手快上一毫秒。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, celebrating our recent AI adoption is biologically laughable. As the Red Queen in Alice in Wonderland stated, 'It takes all the running you can do, to keep in the same place.' This is the 'Red Queen Hypothesis' of evolutionary biology! We evolve, but our competitors, hackers, and regulators co-evolve simultaneously! GenAI is not a competitive moat; it is the bare minimum biological requirement to not go extinct today. Today's mandate awakens this enterprise's Darwinian instinct. Abandon the hallucination of 'sustainable advantage.' In the AI arms race, our sole strategy is ensuring our mutation rate remains one millisecond faster than the apex predators hunting us.

slide_title.zh: 間斷平衡：AI 隕石與演化躍進 (Punctuated Equilibrium & The Asteroid)
slide_title.en: Punctuated Equilibrium: The AI Asteroid & Evolutionary Leaps

zh: 漸進論的幻覺 (The Illusion of Gradualism)：傳統企業戰略假設進步是線性的（每年成長 10%）。但古生物學家古爾德 (Stephen Jay Gould) 證明，演化是「間斷平衡 (Punctuated Equilibrium)」：幾百萬年的無聊停滯，被突如其來的隕石撞擊（寒武紀大爆發）打斷，引發瞬間的物種大滅絕與暴力進化
GenAI 即寒武紀隕石 (GenAI as the Cambrian Asteroid)：Generative AI 不是一個漸進的軟體升級，它是砸在商業生態系上的隕石。恐龍（傳統巨頭）因為體型龐大、無法突變而瞬間滅絕；而邊緣的哺乳動物（敏捷新創）將接管地球
ISO 42001 的突變護盾 (ISO 42001 as the Mutation Shield)：在環境劇變時，盲目突變也會致死。AI 治理 (ISO 42001) 是企業在核冬天中的「太空衣」。它不是要限制突變，而是確保突變基因（新 AI 專案）具備抗毒性與合規存活性
en: The Illusion of Gradualism: Legacy corporate strategy assumes progress is linear (10% annual growth). Paleontologist Stephen Jay Gould proved evolution is 'Punctuated Equilibrium': millions of years of boring stasis, abruptly violently interrupted by an asteroid strike (the Cambrian Explosion), triggering mass extinction and hyper-mutation.

GenAI as the Cambrian Asteroid: Generative AI is not a gradual software patch; it is an asteroid annihilating the commercial ecosystem. Dinosaurs (legacy monopolies) will go extinct instantly due to an inability to mutate, while fringe mammals (agile startups) inherit the earth.

ISO 42001 as the Mutation Shield: During extreme environmental collapse, blind mutation is also lethal. AI Governance (ISO 42001) is the enterprise's 'Spacesuit' in the nuclear winter. It does not prevent mutation; it guarantees the mutated genes (new AI projects) possess the toxic-resistance and compliance necessary to survive.

speaker_notes.zh: 商學院教我們要做『五年戰略規劃』，古生物學家會笑我們無知。地球的歷史證明，演化根本不是慢慢來的，而是『間斷平衡』。平靜了幾千萬年，突然一顆隕石砸下來，環境瞬間改變，適應不了的恐龍就死光了！GenAI 就是那顆砸在我們頭上的隕石。現在的市場環境已經發生了寒武紀大爆發，那些還在追求『每年漸進成長 10%』的高管，就是正在等死的恐龍。我們必須發動最暴力的組織突變！同時，為了確保突變不會變成畸形（違法侵權），ISO 42001 AI 治理就是我們在惡劣環境中穿上的防輻射衣，確保我們活著走出這個滅絕期。
speaker_notes.en: Business schools teach '5-Year Strategic Plans.' Paleontologists laugh at this ignorance. Earth's history proves evolution is not gradual; it is 'Punctuated Equilibrium.' Millions of years of stasis, instantly shattered by a massive asteroid altering the atmosphere. The dinosaurs who couldn't mutate died! GenAI is the asteroid that just hit our commercial ecosystem. We are in a Cambrian Explosion. Executives still planning for '10% gradual annual growth' are dead dinosaurs walking. We must execute violent organizational mutation! Concurrently, to ensure our mutations aren't deformed (illegal/toxic), ISO 42001 AI Governance is our anti-radiation suit, guaranteeing we survive the extinction event.

slide_title.zh: 水平基因轉移：調解員的瞬間突變魔法 (Horizontal Gene Transfer)
slide_title.en: Horizontal Gene Transfer: The Mutation Magic of the Mediator

zh: 垂直繁衍太慢 (Vertical Descent is Too Slow)：人類靠世代交替演化（垂直繁衍），速度極慢；但細菌能在幾天內產生抗藥性，因為牠們能跨越物種，直接把生存 DNA 傳遞給旁邊的細菌，這叫「水平基因轉移 (Horizontal Gene Transfer, HGT)」
打破組織的生殖隔離 (Shattering Corporate Reproductive Isolation)：企業的部門穀倉 (Silos) 就是「生殖隔離」。等待高層（垂直）發布命令來解決跨部門衝突，速度太慢，公司早被對手殲滅
調解員作為病毒載體 (The Mediator as the Viral Vector)：高階調解員 (Mediator) 是組織內的「有益病毒」。調解員穿梭在衝突的部門間，不靠上對下命令，而是直接將 A 部門的「關鍵生存認知 (DNA)」透過談判，水平植入 B 部門的大腦，在一天內完成全組織的突變與和解
en: Vertical Descent is Too Slow: Humans evolve via generational reproduction (Vertical Descent)—it takes millennia. Bacteria develop antibiotic resistance in days because they physically inject survival DNA directly into neighboring cells across species lines. This is 'Horizontal Gene Transfer (HGT).'

Shattering Reproductive Isolation: Corporate silos are biological 'Reproductive Isolation.' Waiting for the C-Suite to issue top-down (vertical) directives to resolve cross-silo warfare is too slow; the enterprise will be annihilated by agile rivals.

The Mediator as the Viral Vector: The Elite Mediator is a 'Beneficial Virus.' The Mediator operates across hostile silos. Avoiding slow vertical commands, the Mediator extracts critical 'survival data (DNA)' from Dept A and horizontally injects it directly into the brain of Dept B during negotiation, executing enterprise-wide mutation and consensus in a single day.

speaker_notes.zh: 細菌為什麼這麼難殺？因為牠們演化不靠生小孩（垂直），牠們靠『水平基因轉移』！一隻細菌有了抗藥性基因，牠會直接插管把基因送給旁邊的細菌，瞬間全體進化。在我們公司，部門之間就是生殖隔離的，業務不理法務，大家都在等 CEO（垂直）下命令，這太慢了！這時，『高階調解員 (Mediator)』的物理意義就出現了。調解員就是那根傳遞基因的管子，或者說是有益的病毒。我穿梭在死結的部門之間，把 A 部門的底線與痛點（生存基因），直接水平植入 B 部門的認知裡。我不靠權力，我靠水平基因轉移，讓這兩群人瞬間進化成懂得合作的共生體。
speaker_notes.en: Why are bacteria invincible? Because they don't evolve by having children (vertical descent). They use 'Horizontal Gene Transfer'! If one bacterium develops antibiotic resistance, it physically injects that DNA into its neighbor. Instant collective mutation! In our enterprise, silos are reproductively isolated. Waiting for the CEO to issue vertical commands is too slow! This is the ultimate biological function of the 'Executive Mediator.' The Mediator is the viral vector. I bypass the hierarchy, moving horizontally between hostile silos. I extract the bottom-line truth (survival DNA) from Dept A and inject it directly into the cognitive framework of Dept B. I don't use authority; I use horizontal gene transfer to instantly mutate hostile factions into a cooperative symbiote.

slide_title.zh: 演化穩定策略：對抗 AI 背叛者的數學機制 (Evolutionary Stable Strategies)
slide_title.en: Evolutionary Stable Strategies (ESS) & Defeating AI Saboteurs

zh: 演化穩定策略 (ESS, Evolutionary Stable Strategy)：演化賽局理論大師梅納·史密斯提出。一個族群如果採用了 ESS，任何採取其他策略的「少數突變者（叛徒/自私者）」，都會在數學上被自然淘汰，無法入侵該族群
道德勸說必敗於突變者 (Moral Pleading Fails Against Mutants)：如果 AI 治理只靠「道德文化」，只要出現一個為了業績而繞過資安的「自私突變者」，他就會獲得超額獎金。自私基因將迅速感染全公司，合規文化崩潰
將 ISO 42001 打造為 ESS (Architecting ISO 42001 as an ESS)：必須將機制作為環境壓力。讓「嚴格遵守 AI 安全規範」成為公司的 ESS。任何試圖侵權或造假的突變者，其行為會立刻觸發系統的自動阻斷與分紅歸零。讓合規成為唯一能存活的基因
en: Evolutionary Stable Strategy (ESS): Defined by evolutionary game theorist John Maynard Smith. If a population adopts an ESS, any 'minority mutant (traitor/selfish actor)' adopting an alternative strategy will be mathematically out-competed and driven to extinction. The population cannot be invaded.

Moral Pleading Fails Against Mutants: If AI governance relies on 'moral culture,' a single 'selfish mutant' who bypasses cybersecurity to hit a sales quota will receive a massive bonus. That selfish gene will instantly replicate, destroying the compliance culture.

Architecting ISO 42001 as an ESS: We must deploy mechanism design as biological environmental pressure. 'Absolute adherence to AI safety' must become the corporate ESS. Any mutant attempting to infringe IP or fake data will trigger automated systemic blockage and zeroed bonuses. Compliance becomes the ONLY gene capable of survival.

speaker_notes.zh: 在演化賽局理論中，有一個最高境界叫『演化穩定策略 (ESS)』。意思是，當一個群體都採用這個策略時，任何想來搞破壞的『自私突變者』，都會因為拿不到好處而死光。我們在推動 ISO 42001 (AI 治理) 時，千萬不能只靠道德呼籲！如果大家都乖乖守法，突然有一個業務員偷偷用違規的 AI 搶下大單，還拿了獎金（他就是突變者）。全公司看到他活得這麼好，自私基因就會迅速傳播，合規體系瞬間崩潰！我們必須把 AI 治理打造成 ESS。透過嚴格的系統稽核與獎懲，讓那些敢違規的突變者『在數學上必定滅絕』。只有把合規變成唯一能活下去的策略，治理才會成功。
speaker_notes.en: Evolutionary Game Theory defines the supreme state of existence as an 'Evolutionary Stable Strategy (ESS).' It means if a population adopts this strategy, any 'selfish mutant' trying to cheat will be mathematically starved of resources and die. When deploying ISO 42001 (AI Governance), moral pleading is fatal! If everyone obeys the rules, but one salesman uses an illegal AI to close a massive deal and gets a bonus (he is the mutant). The entire company watches him thrive, the selfish gene replicates, and compliance collapses! We must architect AI governance as an ESS. Through algorithmic auditing and ruthless compensation mechanics, we ensure that any mutant attempting to violate compliance goes mathematically extinct. Governance only succeeds when compliance is the only strategy that survives.

slide_title.zh: 100 天演化重構與紅皇后突變藍圖 (100-Day Evolutionary Reboot)

zh: 第 1-30 天 (紅皇后現實審查與漸進論廢除)：由策略長 (CSO) 發動全公司的「隕石撞擊體檢」。停止慶祝微小的 AI 進步；以競爭對手與駭客的進化速度為基準，強迫高管面對「不極速突變即滅絕」的生物學現實
第 31-100 天 (基因轉移調解與 ESS 護欄上線)：全面部署高階調解員進行跨部門的「水平基因轉移」，在一週內化解舊有死結；同時，將 ISO 42001 硬編碼為企業的「演化穩定策略 (ESS)」，徹底滅絕違規基因
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會認知「我們不是在經營公司，我們是在參與物種演化」。授權我們啟動達爾文式的戰略重構，拋棄溫情主義，用生命科學的無情法則，打造地球上最具適應力的頂級掠食者
en: Days 1-30 (Red Queen Reality Check & Gradualism Purge): CSO triggers an enterprise-wide 'Asteroid Impact Diagnostic.' Halt all celebrations of minor AI progress. Benchmarking against the mutation rates of apex competitors and hackers, forcing the C-Suite to face the biological reality of 'Hyper-Mutate or Die.'

Days 31-100 (HGT Mediation & ESS Guardrail Deployment): Mass deployment of Elite Mediators to execute 'Horizontal Gene Transfer' across silos, annihilating legacy deadlocks in days. Concurrently, hard-coding ISO 42001 as the corporate 'Evolutionary Stable Strategy (ESS)' to exterminate rogue genes.

Call to Action: Requesting the Board acknowledge that 'We are not running a company; we are engaged in species evolution.' Authorizing this Darwinian restructure, abandoning sentimentality, and wielding the ruthless laws of bioscience to forge the ultimate apex predator.

speaker_notes.zh: 這是未來 100 天的企業演化重構藍圖。第一個月，策略長必須打破大家的安逸。不要再為了會寫幾句 ChatGPT 提示詞而鼓掌，紅皇后假說告訴我們，對手跑得比我們還快。我們要把『漸進主義』的教科書燒掉。接下來的兩個月，調解員全面出動，像病毒一樣在各部門間穿梭，進行『水平基因轉移』，把卡死的專案瞬間打通。同時，人資與法務要把 ISO 42001 變成公司的『演化穩定策略』，讓任何違規的突變者自動滅亡。懇請董事會授權，大自然是殘酷的，不進化就滅絕，讓我們用演化生物學的智慧，帶領這家公司成為 AI 時代的頂級掠食者。
speaker_notes.en: This is our 100-day Evolutionary Reboot Blueprint. In Month 1, the CSO shatters our complacency. Stop clapping because someone wrote a ChatGPT prompt. The Red Queen Hypothesis proves our rivals are mutating faster. We will incinerate the textbook of 'Gradualism.' Over Months 2 and 3, Mediators deploy like viral vectors, executing 'Horizontal Gene Transfer' across hostile silos, unclogging deadlocked projects instantly. Simultaneously, Legal and HR will hard-code ISO 42001 into the corporate compensation matrix as an 'Evolutionary Stable Strategy (ESS),' mathematically exterminating rogue mutants. I ask the Board to mandate this. Nature is ruthless: mutate or die. Let us deploy evolutionary biology to forge this enterprise into the apex predator of the GenAI era.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『演化生物學與紅皇后戰略』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或策略長 (CSO)。內容必須將達爾文以來的頂尖生命科學降維應用於企業變革、AI 治理與高階調解：1. 運用 SCQA 點出企業對 AI 進步的沾沾自喜，實則違反了『紅皇后假說 (不拼命奔跑即滅絕)』，2. 導入『間斷平衡 (Punctuated Equilibrium)』，證明 GenAI 是砸在商業生態系的隕石，漸進式成長必死無疑，3. 將『高階調解 (Mediation)』完美隱喻為細菌的『水平基因轉移 (HGT)』，說明調解員如何跨越階層，瞬間將生存共識植入對立部門，4. 運用梅納史密斯的『演化穩定策略 (ESS)』，證明 ISO 42001 必須設計成讓『違規突變者』自動滅絕的環境壓力，5. 結尾給出 100 天演化重構與突變藍圖。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具達爾文式的殘酷物競天擇感、洞穿生命底層邏輯的哲學深度，以及頂級掠食者的絕對霸氣。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Evolutionary Biology & Red Queen Strategy' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Chief Strategy Officer. Demonstrate the elite application of Darwinian bioscience to corporate transformation, AI Governance, and Advanced Mediation: 1. Use SCQA to frame the enterprise's complacency in AI adoption as a fatal violation of the 'Red Queen Hypothesis' (sprint or die). 2. Introduce 'Punctuated Equilibrium,' proving GenAI is an asteroid striking the ecosystem, rendering gradual linear growth a death sentence. 3. Flawlessly map 'Advanced Mediation' to bacterial 'Horizontal Gene Transfer (HGT),' explaining how Mediators bypass hierarchy to instantly inject survival consensus across hostile silos. 4. Utilize John Maynard Smith's 'Evolutionary Stable Strategy (ESS)' to prove ISO 42001 must be architected as an environmental pressure that mathematically exterminates 'rogue compliance mutants.' 5. Conclude with a 100-Day Evolutionary Reboot & Mutation Blueprint. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project the ruthless reality of Darwinian natural selection, profound philosophical insight into the laws of life, and the absolute dominance of an apex predator.
